name: 01376 · Turners Falls, MA
findings: ZIP 01376 (Turners Falls) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01376 (Turners Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01376 (Turners Falls) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
